# Task A synthetic admission fixtures

`complete-synthetic.json` is a deliberately synthetic revision assembled for admission tests. Its source, rights, quantities, yield, storage instructions, image and portion evidence are test premises, not accepted cooking or content records. No actual image file is claimed: the native basis explicitly supplies the synthetic verified asset digest.

Evidence ID suffixes: 01 source/text rights, 02 quantity review, 03 dietary review, 04 dietary fact, 05 portion premise, 06 storage rule, 07 independent image rights, 08 classification. The test builder supplies distinct synthetic evidence revisions/digests. Native callers must obtain real semantic attestations from the trusted admission boundary; arbitrary IDs, actor labels or a matching digest are insufficient there. Core can check exact reference and pin closure, not independently authenticate a native caller's assertion.

`manifest.json` inventories all 37 executable integration tests and error-path checks. Tests read the root-owned unchanged 55-scenario oracle directly, selecting exactly the A portions of F52/F53. No expected output is generated by production admission code. The complete fixture and its mutations exercise the four FOOD-R1-01 groups and root's food-a-diagnostics ruling.

The returned assessment is authoritative for computed capabilities and diagnostics. The original recipe remains immutable, including imported issue claims. Missing/Unknown classification or absent storage rules permit supported fresh shopping with leftovers=false. An asserted rule/review/portion/dietary fact whose evidence ID is absent from the admitted basis is a dangling claim and rejects; omitted facts differ from asserted but unauthenticated facts.

Every component must link exactly every recipe storage rule naming it; partial linkage rejects as DomainConflict even when leftovers is claimed false or classification is missing/Unknown. General/Rice classification and all admitted same-component source rules are retained for later consumers. A computes reuse prerequisites and ceiling minima; actual 48h/24h/18h scheduled-use boundaries remain Task C. B eligibility/servings/scaling, store snapshot immutability, external provenance/currentness, and all real cooking/child-portion evidence remain outside this test target. No 55-case conformance claim follows.
